communications.textHTML:
Staying safe and well at our Hotel

Dear Customer,

We are pleased to inform you that we have taken all the health and safety measures requested by the competent authority in order to guarantee total security to our guests and staff.

We ensure compliance with the hygiene standards in common areas, rooms and within contacts with our team, so that you can enjoy your holiday with happiness and ease.

You will be able to personally check these procedures at your arrival in hotel without giving up any comfort.

Our health and safety procedures are as follows:

  • Continuous cleaning and sanitizing of all areas, rooms, halls and meeting points.
  • Deep and carefull disinfection of all surfaces that you can possibly touch (door handles, lifts, welcome desks, toilets, etc… ) several times a day.
  • Protection devices for all our staff.
  • Hand sanitizer located in different areas.
  • Staff highly trained in security procedures.
  • Streamlining measures for check-in and check-out.
  • Room service on request.
  • Personal protection devices available for guests on request.

We are happy to welcome you: Your Wellness is our main task.

Dear Customer,

In accordance with applicable privacy laws (EU Regulations n. 679, 2016), we would like to take this opportunity to inform you that your personal information will be processed in an ethical and transparent manner, only for lawful purposes, and in a manner that safeguards your privacy and your rights.

Processing takes place manually and using IT tools, and is done for the following purposes:

1. To obtain and confirm your booking of accommodations and other services, and to provide such services as requested. Since this processing is required to define our contractual relationship and to perform under our contract with you, your consent is mandatory. Should you refuse to submit your personal information, we will not be able to confirm your booking or provide you with the requested services. Processing shall cease after you check out, although some of your personal information may (or in some instances, has to) continue to be processed for the purposes and in the manner described below;

2. To comply with our “Public Safety Law” (Article 109 Royal Decree n. 773, 18/6/1931) which requires that we provide identification data of our guests to the police, for purposes of public safety, in the manner established by the Ministry of the Interior (Decree of 7 January 2013). Data submission is mandatory and does not require your consent. Should you refuse to provide such information, we will not be able to host you in our hotel. Data acquired for such purposes shall not be retained by us;

3. To comply with applicable administrative, accounting, and tax regulations. For these purposes, your consent is not required. Personal information is processed by us and our persons in charge of data processing and is disclosed outside the company only when and if required by law. Should you refuse to submit the required data for the above purposes, we will not be able to provide you with the requested services. Data acquired for such purposes is retained by us for the required statutory period (10 years – or longer, in case of tax audits);

4. To speed-up check-in on your next visit to our hotel. For such purposes, upon obtaining your consent at the time of check-in (which can be revoked at any moment), your information will be retained and will be used the next time you are our guest, for the reasons listed above;

5. To send you advertising messages and updates on special offers and promotions. For this purpose, upon obtaining your optional consent, your information shall be retained and will not be disclosed to third parties. You may revoke your consent at any moment;

We also would like to inform you that the European Regulation grant you certain rights, including rights of access to, adjustment, erasure, limitation of, or objection to the processing of your data, as well as data portability rights, when and insofar as applicable (Articles 15-22 of the EU Regulations n. 679, 2016). You can also file a complaint with the Data Protection Authority, according to the procedures set forth under applicable regulations.


For any other concern, and to assert your rights under the EU Regulation, please contact:

Società Agricola Albafiorita di Sarti Laura e De Marchi Dino S.S.

Privacy manager:
Dino De Marchi

Email: info@albafiorita.com

offers.descriptionHTML:
Package includes:
- 3 nights in a double room at our farmhouse	
- Artisan breakfast, with homemade cakes, local meats and cheeses, etc.
- Welcome drink, with cicchetto and a glass of our Prosecco	
- Guided tour of the vineyards and winery
- Tasting of 5 selected wines, accompanied by Prosciutto Crudo di San Daniele, cheeses and cured meats from Friuli	
- Boat excursion in the Marano Lagoon with a stop at the ‘Bilancia di Bepi’ and subsequent transfer to a traditional lagoon hut to enjoy a glass of wine.
- Relax in the new swimming pool, surrounded by the vineyards and flowers of the beautiful season	
- Possibility of late check-out, subject to availability
- A complimentary bottle as a memento of your stay in Albafiorita

Offer valid from 01 September to 15 November 2026
Minimum stay: 3 nights
offers.name: TRIALS THROUGH VINEYARDS AND THE LAGOON

offers.descriptionHTML:
Four nights in a Standard Room with breakfast for two people, with typical products and homemade desserts.
Treat yourself to a break in the heart of Friuli: four nights in Albafiorita, one of which is complimentary, combined with the relaxation of the Bibione Thermal Baths, wine tastings, the flavors of San Daniele ham, and a guided nature tour in Val Grande.

The package includes four experiences:
Tasting of 5 selected wines, accompanied by San Daniele Raw Ham, Friulian cheeses and cold cuts, and a guided tour of the vineyards
One admission per person to the thermal pools and Wellness area at the Bibione Thermal Baths
Visit with tasting at a San Daniele ham processing plant
Admission to the Val Grande Nature Oasis in Bibione

and also:
Welcome aperitif, with a small bite and a glass of our Prosecco
Artisanal breakfast, with homemade cakes, local cold cuts and cheeses, etc.
One complimentary bottle as a keepsake of your stay at Albafiorita

Offer valid for stays until December 31, 2026.
Free cancellation up to 5 days before arrival.
